rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_copd;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_copd(
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid,seq)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE AS 
SELECT d.hospcode,d.pid,d.seq,d.date_serv
FROM tmp_diag_opd  d  
INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON d.hospcode=s.hospcode AND d.pid=s.pid AND d.seq=s.seq
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode  AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON  d.cid=p.cid
WHERE  d.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) 
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,CONCAT(@b_year,'0101')) >=15
AND SUBSTR(d.diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441')  AND d.diagtype IN(1)

;

INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_copd (
SELECT d.hospcode,d.pid,s.seq,DATE_FORMAT(d.datetime_disch,'%Y%m%d')
FROM tmp_diag_ipd  d  
INNER JOIN tmp_admission s ON d.hospcode=s.hospcode AND d.pid=s.pid AND d.an=s.an
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON  d.cid=p.cid
WHERE  DATE_FORMAT(d.datetime_disch,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) 
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,CONCAT(@b_year,'0101')) >=15
AND SUBSTR(d.diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441')  AND d.diagtype IN(1)
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_copd_death15(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_copd_death15 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_copd_death15 (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target)
(
SELECT
  @id,p.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) target
FROM
t_person_cid p INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.hospcode=h.hoscode 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND p.age_y >=15
AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY check_hosp
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO  s_copd_death15 (id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target)
(SELECT @id,t.hospcode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year,0 as target
FROM tmp_copd t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY t.hospcode
);

UPDATE s_copd_death15 s INNER JOIN 
(SELECT hospcode
,count(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12) ,CONCAT(hospcode,pid,seq),NULL)) resultq1
,count(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3) ,CONCAT(hospcode,pid,seq),NULL)) resultq2
,count(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6) ,CONCAT(hospcode,pid,seq),NULL)) resultq3
,count(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9) ,CONCAT(hospcode,pid,seq),NULL)) resultq4
FROM tmp_copd 
GROUP BY hospcode
) t ON s.hospcode=t.hospcode SET s.resultq1=t.resultq1 , s.resultq2=t.resultq2 , s.resultq3=t.resultq3 , s.resultq4=t.resultq4
WHERE  s.b_year=(@b_year+543);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
